clue.text: Kitchen device to ruin plumbing fitment

parts.note: to dish someone's hopes is to ruin them
a washer is the ring that seals a tap or pipe joint

explanation.surface: An instruction for vandalising a kitchen appliance by wrecking its pipework.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that cleans plates and cutlery is a standard piece of kitchen equipment.

clue.text: Party leaders in politics expect information

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: leaders means the initial letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A party's top people in politics are expecting a briefing.
explanation.definitionFit: Dope is slang for inside facts, as in getting the low-down.

clue.text: Most of certain area offloading millions of unusual paintings?

indicators.note: most of means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: sure means certain

indicators.note: offloading means the abbreviation for millions is dropped

parts.note: a realm is a domain or area

explanation.surface: Speculation about an area shedding millions of oddball paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: The dreamlike style of Dali and Magritte gives its name to anything bizarre.

clue.text: Hunter perhaps reset gin, with transient opportunity for observation

parts.note: a hunter is a pocket watch with a protective lid

indicators.note: reset means the letters of gin are arranged anew

parts.note: brief means short-lived

explanation.surface: A hunter resets a gin trap, with a brief chance to watch.
explanation.walkthrough: A hunter is a pocket watch whose glass is covered by a hinged lid.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawyer instructed to follow a case for an interested party, without taking part, is there to monitor.

clue.text: One guards small number of competitors

parts.note: the entry for a race is the field of competitors

explanation.surface: A single guard protects a small field of contestants.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier posted to keep watch is someone who protects a position.

clue.text: I creep about, going after each listening device

indicators.note: going after puts the rearranged letters behind the abbreviation for each
about means the letters of the two words are moved around

explanation.surface: A snoop creeping round behind people with a bugging device.
explanation.definitionFit: A small speaker worn in the ear lets one hear a phone or radio.

clue.text: Item is piano tune

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly
an air is a melody

explanation.surface: Someone identifying a catalogue item as a piano piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Item' is used in the sense of a romantic couple, as in 'they're an item'.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people in a relationship are called an item, which is a couple.

clue.text: 6 ceding power left transport hub

indicators.note: ceding means giving up the letter for power

parts.note: the answer to 6 across, a couple
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A couple give up power and leave for a travel terminal.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' points to the answer at 6 across.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where planes take off and land is a major centre for travel.

clue.text: Original shell of confectionery recreated in sugary coating

indicators.note: recreated means the letters are made over in a new order
the shell is the outermost letters of the word

explanation.surface: An original confectionery shell remade in a sweet glaze.
explanation.definitionFit: The hard white frosting on wedding and Christmas cakes is a sweet topping.

clue.text: Hell surrounding Biblical city seen by an austere religious follower

indicators.note: the word for hell is wrapped around the Biblical city

parts.note: the pit is an old name for hell
Ur of the Chaldees is the city Abraham came from in Genesis

explanation.surface: A strict believer looks on as an ancient city is engulfed by hellfire.
explanation.definitionFit: Seventeenth-century Protestants who wanted a stricter, plainer church were known for their severity.

clue.text: Note cut lines — join again?

indicators.note: cut here means the word for note loses its tail

parts.note: a remark is a comment, something one notes
RY, railway, is the usual abbreviation for lines

explanation.surface: A query whether a note shortened by some lines should be stuck back together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks the final K from REMARK.
explanation.definitionFit: To wed once more is to be joined in marriage a second time; the question mark flags the playful sense.

clue.text: Crumbling Gothic remnant — it's something of an attraction

indicators.note: crumbling means the letters fall apart and are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A crumbling Gothic ruin is a draw for tourists.
explanation.definitionFit: Compass needles are pulled towards this point, so it is literally a pull of magnetism.

clue.text: Herd straying and straying? Don't follow it

indicators.note: cattle wandering off are scattered, so the letters of herd are rearranged

parts.note: erring means wandering from the right path

explanation.surface: Cattle wandering off, with a warning not to go after them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'straying' does two jobs in turn: first it scrambles HERD into RED, then it is read again as ERRING.
explanation.definitionFit: A misleading clue planted to divert attention is something a detective should not pursue.

clue.text: Something that swoops near the ground, head right back

indicators.note: the first letter is sent all the way to the far end of the word

parts.note: low means close to the ground

explanation.surface: A bird diving low with its head thrown back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head right back' moves the L of LOW to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: This night bird of prey glides down onto mice and voles.

clue.text: Representation to go up — way to attract Liberal

indicators.note: to attract means to draw the letter for Liberal onto its end

parts.note: to scale a wall is to climb it
a mode is a way of doing something

explanation.surface: A political strategy for winning over Liberal voters.
explanation.definitionFit: A miniature replica built in proportion represents the real object.

clue.text: Stop last of dodgy group of settlers

parts.note: a colon is a punctuation stop

indicators.note: only the final letter of dodgy is taken

explanation.surface: An instruction to halt the remaining bits of something shady.
explanation.definitionFit: A settlement founded by migrants in a new land is a group of incomers living together.

clue.text: Exciting about Conservative (not Republican) taking a broad view

indicators.note: not here tells us the Republican letter is dropped
the exciting word goes round the abbreviation for Conservative

parts.note: an electric atmosphere is thrilling

explanation.surface: A political observer calls a broad-minded Tory, unlike a Republican, thrilling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts C inside ELECTRIC, giving ECLECTRIC; '(not Republican)' then removes R.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with wide-ranging tastes draws from many sources rather than a single school.

clue.text: Upset record number entering target country

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the whole is turned upside down
the record and number go inside the word for target

parts.note: an aim is a target
a log is a record

explanation.surface: A record-setting figure upsets a country's goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A landlocked nation between Russia and China is a sovereign state.

clue.text: Marine marker left by second person returning after start of month

indicators.note: after places the reversed pronoun behind the date

parts.note: 1 Feb, written I FEB, is the first day of a month

indicators.note: returning means the pronoun is read backwards

parts.note: you is the second-person pronoun

explanation.surface: A sea marker left by someone coming back at the start of a month.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'start of month' is a date, 1 FEB, with the 1 written as I.
explanation.definitionFit: A floating ring kept at sea and on quays is a familiar marine object, here loosely a marker.

clue.text: Fine supplier of puzzles, overlooking first one cheating

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads

indicators.note: overlooking first means the opening letter is ignored

parts.note: a riddler sets riddles

explanation.surface: A fine setter of puzzles caught cheating.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindler who fiddles the books is a cheat.

clue.text: Nothing quartet recalled about old instrument

indicators.note: the reversed letters go round the abbreviation for old
recalled means the two pieces are read backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A string quartet remembered playing an old instrument for nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: This four-stringed bowed instrument leads the string section of an orchestra.

clue.text: Varnish nearly all fine material? Question stopping short

indicators.note: nearly all means the last letter is lost

parts.note: lace is a delicate fabric

indicators.note: stopping short means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a query is a question

explanation.surface: Asking whether a varnish covers nearly all fine fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard glossy coating applied to wood is a kind of varnish.

clue.text: Usual trick, hiding ring and military medal

indicators.note: hiding means the trick conceals the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a con is a swindle
O is ring-shaped
MM is the Military Medal

explanation.surface: A routine scam of concealing a ring and a service medal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ordinary and widespread is commonplace and familiar.

clue.text: Servant, giving one away, cracked

indicators.note: giving one away means the numeral-like letter is removed

parts.note: a maid is a female servant
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A servant who betrayed someone finally broke down.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has cracked has gone crazy, a slang sense of losing one's mind.

clue.text: Healthy as a pampered inmate?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for being in fine condition
nick is British slang for prison, so a cosseted prisoner is in a good jail

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a spoilt prisoner counts as healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in sound condition, said of people and of things like used cars.

clue.text: Communiqué given no time in part of military base

indicators.note: given no means the word for time is removed

parts.note: a communiqué is an official message
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A dispatch sent without delay to part of an army camp.
explanation.definitionFit: The dining hall where soldiers eat together is a place on a base.

clue.text: Threatening to have party for graduate suffering grief

indicators.note: party for graduate means one replaces the other

parts.note: baleful means menacing
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Someone grieving is menaced into hosting a party for a new graduate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to have party for graduate' swaps the BA in BALEFUL for DO.
explanation.definitionFit: A mournful person is sorrowful, as one is when grieving.

clue.text: Brand of motor ending in remote display area

parts.note: a marque is a make of car

indicators.note: only the last letter of remote is used

explanation.surface: A car brand shown off at the far end of a showground.
explanation.definitionFit: A large tent put up at a show serves as a space for exhibits.

clue.text: Line chest for a bit of fun

parts.note: an ark is a chest, as in the Ark of the Covenant

explanation.surface: Lining a chest just for fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something for a laugh is a prank or spree, done for amusement.

clue.text: What you get up to in the way of tweeting

definitions.text: What you get up to in the way of tweeting

parts.words: What you get up to in the way of tweeting
parts.note: tweeting suggests social media, but here it is birdsong heard when you rise at daybreak

explanation.surface: A question about one's social-media habits.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds sing together at first light, the noise that greets early risers.
